title: the surface heaves on the one-drop, then turns
story: Relax dancehall riddim at 129 tracker BPM (half-time feel ~65). The reaction-diffusion surface heaves on every kick (ola_alto), flashes on every snare (filo + brightness), and steps its flow direction once per bar. At the section change (tick 2860) the flow reverses over one bar and the hue steps, then the double hit at 3218/3224 folds the surface twice with a shake that gets stronger. The post-roll keeps the reversed flow and the bar sway.
